scenario: An `after` TIMER replayed ([LFST.9.1], [LTAC.3]). `arm` defers `emit Late` by 30_s and captures `t.v` for it ([LTAC.3.5]). Trig 1 at 0, Trig 2 at 20_s, pumps at 35_s and 55_s: the deferred body for 1 fires at the 35_s pump and the one for 2 at the 55_s pump, re-activated each pump by the engine's `$ClockTick` and admitted by the fire guard only once the instant has passed. The timer, the capture and the tick are all engine-made, so the replay must re-derive every one from its own clock. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Late scope ttl 1_h:
    v: Int

rule arm:
    Trig t
->
    after 30_s:
        emit Late v: t.v
